purpose: Smallest generic data-driven state-trigger facility. A trigger observes ordinary run state at the end of a year and, when its condition holds, enqueues an authored future event. It is not a meter: nothing is stored, no numeric value accumulates, and the condition grammar is unchanged.
rules: A trigger may only schedule an authored event that already exists in the corpus.
offsetYears must be at least 1, so a trigger can never produce a second visible event in the same year.
A trigger never produces an ending, never changes stats, flags, material or faction state, and never selects a variant.
Duplicate suppression is mandatory: a trigger does not fire while its target is already pending, while suppressWhile holds, or once the target's repeat policy is exhausted.
Every trigger is declared here in canonical data. The engine hard-codes none of them.

triggers.notes: H2B.1A A-04. An adult at STR<=-3 with no active or pending review gets one scheduled for the following year. Coverage does not stop at 69; the reviewed events carry no upper age bound. The trigger schedules a review and never an ending.
